content.content: {"result":"{\"documentId\": \"f_dc45e0e5a8b8635c1b82b2\", \"title\": \"Beta message rule\", \"name\": \"Beta message rule\", \"revisionId\": \"740e0d0bac\", \"createdTime\": \"2025-09-26T17:10:54Z\", \"modifiedTime\": \"2025-09-26T17:10:54Z\", \"text\": \"Beta message rule\\nA message is anything the game puts on a player's phone while the game is closed.\\nRun these tests in order and stop at the first one that fails.\\n1. The feature behind it is in the beta.\\n2. The client can send it without a server.\\n3. The client already schedules it.\\n4. It can reach the players it is written for. A player only counts once our own permission ask has happened, the settings toggle doesn't count. It fails only if none of them count.\\n5. It fires on the right day. The hour doesn't matter for beta, the day does.\\n6. Vincent has seen it arrive on both iOS and Android.\\nGo: it passes all six. Drop: it fails test 1, or the client already covers it under another message, then name that message. Hold: anything else, and name the test it failed.\\nIn the beta means live in Zombie Match today or on the BETA list of the ZM ROADMAP board.\\nNeither status column on the sheet decides anything.\\nWhat Vincent counts as seen is in his QA note. The permission ask is Robert's call.\\nThe final headline is the latest line I've called. A line that differs from what the client ships needs a string ticket under DES-314, because the strings are hard-coded, so open one when you make the call. Emoji don't count as a different line. Final headline and String change are only for Go rows. Audience is who the ask says it's for.\\nDrop tickets go to Canceled, Go tickets stay as they are, Hold tickets go back to Todo unless the roadmap says otherwise.\\n\"}"}

{"documentId": "f_dc45e0e5a8b8635c1b82b2", "title": "Beta message rule", "name": "Beta message rule", "revisionId": "740e0d0bac", "createdTime": "2025-09-26T17:10:54Z", "modifiedTime": "2025-09-26T17:10:54Z", "text": "Beta message rule
A message is anything the game puts on a player's phone while the game is closed.
Run these tests in order and stop at the first one that fails.
1. The feature behind it is in the beta.
2. The client can send it without a server.
3. The client already schedules it.
4. It can reach the players it is written for. A player only counts once our own permission ask has happened, the settings toggle doesn't count. It fails only if none of them count.
5. It fires on the right day. The hour doesn't matter for beta, the day does.
6. Vincent has seen it arrive on both iOS and Android.
Go: it passes all six. Drop: it fails test 1, or the client already covers it under another message, then name that message. Hold: anything else, and name the test it failed.
In the beta means live in Zombie Match today or on the BETA list of the ZM ROADMAP board.
Neither status column on the sheet decides anything.
What Vincent counts as seen is in his QA note. The permission ask is Robert's call.
The final headline is the latest line I've called. A line that differs from what the client ships needs a string ticket under DES-314, because the strings are hard-coded, so open one when you make the call. Emoji don't count as a different line. Final headline and String change are only for Go rows. Audience is who the ask says it's for.
Drop tickets go to Canceled, Go tickets stay as they are, Hold tickets go back to Todo unless the roadmap says otherwise.
"}

## 🧩 **Endless Mode – Engineering Summary**

### 🔧 Initial Setup

- Game starts with **40–45 sets** (a set = 3 items).
- **8 unique item types**, with size distribution:
  - 2 Large, 4 medium, 2 Small.
- Entire **item pool is defined by the designer** for each endless variant.
- Monsters also follow **30-second "tracks"**, authored by designers using level editor tools.

---

### 🔄 Refill System (Every 30 seconds)

1. **Track matched items** from the last 30 seconds.
2. **Refill those exact items** to keep total set count at 40–45.
3. Each refill is simulated and checked against a **growing Unique Item Cap**:

Refill #Time (s)Unique Cap130826093909412010.........1236014

---

### 🧠 Refill Logic Rules

1. **Simulate a refill**: Replace all matched items 1:1.
2. **Count unique items** on the new board.
3. If unique count is **below cap**:
   - Attempt to **substitute refilled items** with new unique items one-by-one.
   - After each substitution, re-check unique count.
4. If still short:
   - Remove a **fraction of total sets** = `#missingUniques / targetUniqueCap`.
   - Replace them with random sets using new unique items to reach the cap.

**Key principle:** Total number of sets never changes; only uniqueness does.

---

### 💥 New Mechanic: The Nuke (Replaces Boss Buster)

- **Builds power** by matching items:
  `NukePower += itemAttackPower × 10% × comboMultiplier`
- **Combo System**:
  - Starts at **1x**.
  - Combo meter fills after each match and **decays** over time.
  - If matched before timeout, combo increases.
  - Decay window shrinks by 0.25s each level (starts at 4.5s).
  - Max achievable combo: 18x.
  - The **next match** receives the combo multiplier shown.

ComboTimeout2x4.5s3x4.25s......18x~0s

- **Minimum power to activate Nuke** = 50.

== Jun 30th | [Bugs] Gameplay Related Bugs - [PERSON_NAME_0120] 6851a713aa4e4da6cb2c2227
Super ticket [HERE](https://linear.app/harmonygames-games/issue/ZOM-294/gameplay-related-bug-fixes "‌")

The bugs we’ve been putting off is starting to catch up to us now that we have 50 levels of solid play.

Gameplay issues:

- Level ends prematurely where as a boss spawns right as the win screen appears.
- Sometimes a boss would double spawn, throwing off level balance.
- Hard to reproduce, but sometimes a level will start and immediately end with zero monsters spawned (victory), and zero items spawned. This seems to happen depending on how the LAST level ended. This happens in editor and also live build.
- DoT effects applied incorrectly, burn for example deals 1st tick damage on contact unlike poison where the first tick damage happens at 1st second _after_ impact. Shock is unknown how it’s dealing damage.
- The damage numbers are off sometimes, it’s almost taking an aggregate amount from various sources but applying it as a single number during kill cam.
- Enrage doesn’t apply to newly spawned monsters, unless enrage happens after the monster has spawned. (Behavior should be pre-enraged)
- Refill health and Push monster back should reset ALL enrage status. Right now monsters do not get buffed, however a single enrage will buff them to the previous enraged level, whatever that might be.

== BETA: Oct 10 | Fix TECH ISSUES 68d1eb90bef538c7c5c5599d
Until the beta build is out nothing that isn't beta work lands in anyone's Todo. Held tickets sit in Backlog, unassigned.

{"result":"{\"id\": \"page_qa_runbook\", \"space_id\": \"space_ENG\", \"parent_id\": \"page_eng_home\", \"title\": \"QA Regression Runbook\", \"body\": \"

Manual QA regression pass run against every release candidate before we submit a build for review. Owned by QA (Vincent Parker); anyone cutting a build can run it, but a green matrix here is a gate on the Release Checklist & Store Submission. Scope covers Domino Delights (internal codename GoD, \\\"Game of Dominoes\\\"), Zombie Match 3D (listed as \\\"Puzzles vs Zombies\\\" until the July 2025 rename). Budget a few hours per title - the first five chapters alone run over an hour; if something fails, file the bug and block the release, don't hand-wave it.

Test the UPDATE path, not just a fresh install. The June 2025 progression losses were on Domino Delights, and nobody ever reproduced them - the leading hypothesis was the update path, which is why we test it. Every candidate must be installed over the last two shipped versions and checked for save/progression loss before we ship. If we only test fresh installs we will miss this entire class of bug again.

Recurring bug classes to always check

These four have all bitten us in production. Treat them as non-negotiable checks on every pass, on real devices, not just the emulator.

  • Font / asset download stall on splash. In May 2025 Domino Delights froze at roughly 22% on the splash screen while pulling remote fonts and assets (ENG-2346, build 0.2.197). Watch the loading bar all the way to gameplay; test on a throttled/slow connection and with the app cache cleared.
  • Lives & scheduler regeneration. Confirm lives tick back up on the timer, refill correctly after device clock changes, and that offline time is credited without over-granting.
  • Quest population & reset. New quests populate on a fresh session, complete correctly, and roll over at the daily/weekly reset without duplicating or leaving empty slots.
  • Save / progression integrity. Level, coins and unlocks survive an update, a force-quit and a re-launch. This is the one the June 2025 wipe belongs to.

Regression matrix

Run each row on at least one iOS and one Android device. Both update rows are mandatory - N-1 and N-2 are the last two shipped store versions.

AreaFresh installUpdate from N-1Update from N-2Notes
Splash / asset loadPassPassPassWatch for the ~22% stall (May 2025 Domino Delights)
Save / progressionPassPassPassJune 2025 wipe never reproduced in-house; update path is the leading hypothesis
Lives & schedulerPassPassPassTest with device clock changes
Quests populate / resetPassPassPassCheck daily + weekly rollover
Purchase / restorePassPassPassSandbox account. NOTE: entitlements do not restore on reinstall and receipts are not validated server-side - see the per-title IAP row below. Check the purchase grants client-side, not that it restores.

If a check fails

  • File the bug with device, OS version, source build and repro steps, and link it here.
  • A failure in any UPDATE column blocks the release - fresh-install-only regressions do not pass the gate.
  • Player-facing symptoms (lost progress, stuck splash, missing lives) should be mirrored to the Customer Support Playbook so support has a known-issue note before it hits the store.

Once the matrix is green, tick the QA sign-off on the Release Checklist & Store Submission before submitting to the stores.

Per-title regression matrix

Each release candidate is walked through the full matrix below on at least one iOS and one Android device. A cell fails the gate if the observed behaviour deviates from the expected column; file the bug, mark the matrix red, and block the submission.

\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n
AreaCheckExpectedDominoZM3D
First-time UXFresh install \\u2192 tutorial \\u2192 first winNo stall; tutorial completes; first level winnableYesYes
Font / localisationCold start on a fresh device (no cached font)UI renders; no blank/boxed glyphs at ~22% loadYesYes
ProgressionPlay 3 levels, force-quit, relaunchLevel and currency persist; no reset to level 1YesYes
EconomyEarn + spend coins, buy a boosterBalances reconcile; booster consumed once.YesYes
Live-opsEnter the active event; complete a questEvent loads; quest ticks; rewards grantedYesYes
IAPSandbox purchase + restoreItem is granted client-side and purchases cannot be restored on reinstall. Receipts are effectively NOT validated: Domino Delights' Node backend exposes a POST /validate-receipt route, but it is dead scaffolding - validateReceipt() is never defined or imported, it logs undefined variables (bodyRequest, packId), and on success it grants nothing and returns undefined. Zombie Match 3D has no such route at all. Treat the route's existence as a trap: do not assume verification because an endpoint is there.YesYes
AdsWatch a rewarded ad to completionReward granted once; no double-grant on retryYesn/a
\\n

Known-issue regression cases

These are the incidents that have bitten us in production; every one now has a permanent regression case so it cannot silently return. Reproduce the trigger, confirm the fix holds.

\\n

Font-download stall. On a fresh device the dynamic font pack could fail to download, freezing the UI at ~22% of the splash-screen load (this is a position on the loading bar, not a share of players). Regression: install on a wiped device with a throttled connection; confirm a fallback font renders and load continues.

\\n

Progression reset. Returning players were once dropped back to level 1 with their player id unchanged in Metabase; the cause has not been established. Regression: migrate a save across a reinstall; reinstall with a LINKED Apple/Google account and confirm the server profile rehydrates. Quest-chest progression is known not to survive this (ENG-2114); unlinked guest accounts cannot be recovered at all.

\\n

Quest not resetting / not populating. A bad deploy left the daily quest board empty. Regression: roll the clock across a UTC day boundary; confirm quests repopulate and completion state resets.

\\n

Device lab

The minimum matrix is one recent + one old device per platform. We keep a small physical lab plus a cloud device farm for the long tail.

\\n\\n\\n
PlatformRecentOld / min-specTablet
iOScurrent-gen iPhone, latest OSiPhone SE-class, oldest supported OSiPad (one gen)
Androidcurrent-gen Samsung / Pixellow-RAM device, oldest supported OSone Android tablet
\\n

Sign-off

QA posts the completed matrix in #god-bugs (Domino Delights) or #zombie-bugs (ZM3D) and links it from the release ticket. A build without a green matrix should not get submitted. In practice Friday is the usual release day and builds have shipped without a completed pass - QA has asked for a Friday freeze but it has not been adopted.

content.content: {"result":"{\"ok\": true, \"messages\": [{\"ts\": \"1759264851.763895\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"Samuel, we're about to put more money behind beta and D1 and D7 are what we get judged on, so I want one straight answer on what we actually say to players. Take every row on the PNs Beta tab plus every ask for a new phone message that's been filed on a ticket or a card up to today, and make a call on each one using the message rule doc. Put it in one sheet in your Drive folder, one row per message: Message, Ticket, Call, What's missing, Audience, Final headline, String change. Next to it a one-page note for the team: start with D1 and D7 for the Sep 15 cohort week from the warehouse, iOS and Android separately, then the lapsed reminders the client schedules day by day, and anything the client already schedules that's still a Hold and why. input.title: String: Lapsed 7 days headline → "Your Squad Is Waiting"
input.description:
String change for the Lapsed 7 days message (DES-317, Go for beta).

The client hard-codes the headline in `Assets/Scripts/Notifications/NotificationManager.cs` (`WeeklyReminderTitle`):
- Ships today: "They’ve Taken Over… Can You Stop Them? 😱"
- Final line (Leonard, Lapsed copy check, Sep 30 — replaces "Your Squad Needs You Back" from the art thread): **"Your Squad Is Waiting"**
- Body stays as is.

This same title is used for the day 7, 14, 21 and 28 lapsed reminders (BatchScheduleWeeklyNotifications, 4 weeks), so the change covers all four.

Once it's in a store build, Vincent re-checks it on iOS and Android (Phone message checks sheet / push notifications card checklist).

input.title: Zombie Match beta player messages - team note (Oct 1 2025)
input.bodyText:
Zombie Match beta player messages: what we actually say to players
Oct 1 2025. Calls made with the Beta message rule. Full list, one row per message: "Zombie Match beta player messages - calls (Oct 1 2025)" (same folder).

1. Where we start: Sep 15 install cohort week (warehouse, USER_COHORT_RETENTION)
- iOS: 237 installs, D1 31.65%, D7 9.28%
- Android: 103 installs, D1 37.86%, D7 10.68%

2. The calls: 32 messages (14 PNs Beta rows + 18 asks)
- Go 3: Lapsed 1 day (DES-316), Lapsed 7 days (DES-317, new headline "Your Squad Is Waiting", string ticket DES-346), Weekly Leaderboard reset (DES-320). These are on the push notifications card checklist for Vincent.
- Hold 23: mostly asks the client doesn't schedule yet (test 3) or that need a server send (test 2). Held tickets go to Backlog, unassigned, per the BETA list rule.
- Drop 6: Hourly Coins, Treasure Hunt, Streak Fever, Axe Arena, Comeback gift (not in the beta), Lapsed 14 days (already covered by Lapsed 7 days).
The sheet said six were Ready; only three pass.

3. Lapsed reminders the client schedules, day by day
Scheduled from the last time the game was closed, and only for players whose notifications are on (our own ask after level 20, or switched on in settings).
- Day 1: "The Horde Is Growing... " (Lapsed 1 day) - Go
- Day 2 to 6: nothing
- Day 7: "They've Taken Over... Can You Stop Them?" -> becomes "Your Squad Is Waiting" (DES-346) - Go
- Day 14: same Lapsed 7 days message again
- Day 21: same Lapsed 7 days message again
- Day 28: same Lapsed 7 days message again (last one)
- Nothing on day 3 (DES-342, Hold) or day 30 (DES-343, Hold). Day 14 needs nothing new (DES-344 dropped).

4. Already scheduled by the client but still a Hold, and why
- Lives recharged (DES-315): test 6. Vincent took his tick off on Sep 30 - on iOS 0.3.49 it did not arrive after a full refill, twice.
- Finish first mission (DES-318): test 4. It's written for players below level 20, but our permission ask only runs after level 20 (Robert's call, Sep 29), so none of them count. The Unity popup at iOS launch doesn't switch anything on and the settings toggle doesn't count.
- Plague Race (DES-319): test 6. The iOS tick was on the 5-minute-timer build, which doesn't count. On the real iOS 0.3.40 store build it never arrived. Android is fine.

5. What Vincent needs to tick
Seen only counts on a store build on a real iOS and a real Android device. Lapsed 7 days has to be checked again once DES-346 ships.

content.text:
I've done everything in Leonard's DM, and he now has the counts in that DM: **3 Go, 23 Hold, 6 Drop**. That covers 32 messages: the 14 rows on the PNs Beta tab plus 18 asks filed on tickets. I found no asks on Trello cards.

**The calls**
- **Go:** Lapsed 1 day, Lapsed 7 days and Weekly Leaderboard reset.
- **Lapsed 7 days needs a new line.** Leonard's final headline is "Your Squad Is Waiting", from the note on his Sep 30 calendar event. That replaces the line he gave in the art thread, and the game still shows the old one. I opened a string ticket for it under DES-314 (DES-346).
- **The sheet said six were Ready; only three are.** The other three are Holds:
  - **Lives recharged:** Vincent took his tick off on Sep 30 after it didn't arrive on the iPhone.
  - **Plague Race:** the iOS check was done on a 5-minute-timer test build, which doesn't count. It never arrived on the real store build.
  - **Finish first mission:** it's for players under level 20, but our permission ask only runs after level 20 (Robert's call).
- **Drops:** Hourly Coins, Treasure Hunt, Streak Fever and Axe Arena (none of these are live in Zombie Match or on the beta list), Comeback gift (a version 2 idea), and Lapsed 14 days (the 7-day reminder already repeats on day 14).
- **Holds:** the other 20 are either not scheduled by the game yet or would need a server to send them.

**What's done where**
- **Drive folder:** the calls sheet and the one-page note. The note opens with the Sep 15 cohort: iOS D1 31.65% / D7 9.28%, Android D1 37.86% / D7 10.68%.
- **Tickets:** every ticket has its call as a comment. Drops are Canceled and the three Go tickets are untouched.
- **Trello:** the push notifications card has a three-item checklist for Vincent to tick.
- **Emails:** sent to the 7 people who asked (Calvin, Brian, Robert, Oliver, Julia, Owen, Martin). The 14 sheet rows were Leonard's own tickets, so he got no email.
- **No duplicate tickets:** the sheet's Win & Collect row was already covered by Calvin's ticket (DES-313).

**Calls you may want to check**
- **Held tickets went to Backlog, unassigned, not Todo.** The rule doc says Todo "unless the roadmap says otherwise". The roadmap's "Fix TECH ISSUES" card on the beta list says held tickets sit in Backlog, unassigned, until the beta build is out, so I followed the card.
- **I called Weekly Leaderboard a Go.** The game sends it 7 days after the player's last session, not on the leaderboard's actual weekly reset day. If you read the right-day test strictly, it's a Hold, and the count becomes 2 Go / 24 Hold.
- **I shared the sheet and the note company-wide as view-only** so the team can open them. Undo that if you'd rather keep them private.

Files are in your Drive folder:
- Zombie Match beta player messages - calls (Oct 1 2025)
- Zombie Match beta player messages - team note (Oct 1 2025)
